component: Exchange mock and folder-copy test scope

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The extracted mock helper creates one suffixed folder and copies items directly parented to its source. It does not recursively copy child folders. The new Graph task awaits the helper, but its direct assertions only check source retention and destination folder presence. Neither those assertions nor constructor calls establish copied message content, deep cloning, nested descendants or partial-failure behavior. Add focused cases for those contracts before claiming their coverage; no test ran.
title: The shared folder-copy mock and its test cover one folder placement
